Deep absorption of 71 links: GitHub projects, arXiv papers, and articles spanning NT-CORE (7), NT-MIND (7), NT-MEMORY (7), NT-WORLD (6), NT-IO (6), NT-ACT (6), NT-SHIELD (2), NT-META (3), NT-REPAIR (3), NT-GOVERNANCE (1). Key insights: (1) SEAL pipeline distillation (arXiv:2608.27964) advances NT-MIND skill crystallization; (2) E8/HyperCube foundations (arXiv:2606.05608v1, bergson, zvec) anchor NT-CORE reasoning; (3) Agent orchestration patterns (OpenHands, worktrunk, adk-python, router) exemplify NT-ACT action layer; (4) IO/interface systems (htmx, vercel blog, grok-prompts, macai) demonstrate NT-I/O bridging; (5) Memory/token optimization (Mano-P, context-mode, token optimizers) refine NT-MEMORY; (6) Repair/self-healing (ponytail, arxiv:2608.27991, rakazo) address NT-REPAIR; (7) OSINT/shield (Claude-OSINT, rakazo) support NT-SHIELD. Patterns: VSA/HyperCube reuse across bergson/zvec; dual specialization; constellations C0-C6 maturity mapping; runeword combinations; dark forest deletion criteria; heartbeat aggregation for cross-module health.

   Key concepts: plugin_runeword, codebase_awareness, git_workflow, T3_self-test, constellation_C0_C5

2. VICT PAPER (arXiv 2608.28128)
   Title: "VICT: Verifier-Instrumented Credit Tracing for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning"
   NT Domain: NT-MIND (Self-evolution domain)
   Key contributions: Verifier-instrumented credit tracing (executable atoms traced back to actions via dependency-valid proof edges), no learned critic/branch rollouts required, shifts credit assignment from rollout-side inference to verifier-side tracing while preserving terminal reward, ablations rule out dense atom rewards, final-commit credit, temporal proximity, sparsity
   NeoTrix Mapping: SEAL pipeline distillation (verifier atoms = fine-grained knowledge extraction from coarse terminal reward), Runeword analogy (proof edges between atoms = runeword connections, only certain combos carry credit), Constellation link (improvement over outcome-only training = advancing from C0 toward C1/C2 maturity), Self-test tier: T3 production wiring (advantage-tensor change influences real-world policy)
   Key concepts: verifier_instrumented_atoms, SEAL_distillation, proof_edge_runewords, C0_C5_constellation, T3_production_wiring

3. AI-ART-ENGINE (Justin-sky)
   GitHub: github.com/Justin-sky/ai-art-engine
   NT Domain: NT-IO (Interface domain)
   Key features: Built-in MCP server (driven by stdio/HTTP), skill system ("professional skill manuals"), 20+ model-provider support (OpenRouter, OpenAI, DeepSeek, Zhipu, Kimi, xAI, Google, vLLM, Ollama, Volcengine, Kling, MiniMax, Qwen, MagicRouter, Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Luma AI, Lux3D), Node-graph/workflow generation for short-video/ad/feature-film, Object-storage integration (TOS, OSS, COS), Extensible Cordis kernel + declaration-plugin manifest
   NeoTrix Mapping: Runeword analogy (skill + MCP combination = runeword - skill provides "intent" rune prefix, MCP provides "execution" rune suffix; certain combos produce emergent behavior like Scry runeword), Constellation link (each model provider mapped to constellation tier: OpenAI → C4 pipeline-integrated, Ollama → C0 local compile), Self-test tier: 5-dimensional quality-check model maps to T3 production wiring (failed nodes trigger degradation without breaking chain, output influences downstream asset decisions), Domain link: dev/implementer → NT-ACT → Dev-匠 (external agents can drive art workflow)
   Key concepts: MCP_skill_runeword, model_constellation_tiers, T3_quality_check, Cordis_kernel, declaration_plugin
